title: Fix client provider results so all providers show and display Engaged/Not Engaged status

requirements.text: Replace the empty/mock provider list on the Client "Provider Results" page with real backend data so a logged-in client can see every service provider for the selected category (and also support viewing "All Providers" when no category filter is provided).

quotes: ENSURE THAT AS A CLIENT I CAN SEE EVERY SERVICE PROVIDER WHO IS ENGAGED OR NOT. RIGHT NOW I CANT SEE ANYTHING

acceptanceCriteria: When a logged-in client navigates to the provider results screen, the page loads a non-empty list if provider profiles exist in the backend (it must not always be an empty array).
If a category/businessType filter is selected, only providers matching that businessType are shown; if no filter is selected, providers across all business types are shown.
The provider count shown on the page reflects the number of providers returned from the backend query (not a constant 0).

If there are genuinely zero providers for the filter, the UI shows an empty-state that indicates there are no providers for that category (not a placeholder message implying search is not implemented).

requirements.text: Add/extend a backend query API that returns a list of provider profiles suitable for client browsing (including each provider’s current engagement state), and ensure it is callable by authenticated clients.

quotes: ENSURE THAT AS A CLIENT I CAN SEE EVERY SERVICE PROVIDER WHO IS ENGAGED OR NOT. RIGHT NOW I CANT SEE ANYTHING

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a query method that returns an array of ProviderProfileView for browsing/search results, optionally filtered by BusinessType.
Returned ProviderProfileView entries include correct `isEngaged` and `engagementEndTime` values.
If a provider’s `engagementEndTime` is in the past, the provider is returned as Not Engaged (`isEngaged` is false) to clients.
The method is authorized such that authenticated users can call it (consistent with existing getProvider behavior that requires #user permission).

requirements.text: Update the client provider listing UI so each provider card clearly shows engagement status (Engaged / Not Engaged) in English, for every provider in the results grid.

quotes: ENSURE THAT AS A CLIENT I CAN SEE EVERY SERVICE PROVIDER WHO IS ENGAGED OR NOT. RIGHT NOW I CANT SEE ANYTHING

acceptanceCriteria: Each provider card in the results grid displays a visible status indicator with English text that distinguishes Engaged vs Not Engaged (or Available).
The status indicator uses the provider’s `isEngaged` value coming from the backend list query (not only from the preview modal polling).
The UI remains readable on mobile and desktop and does not break the existing card layout.

requirements.text: Add React Query wiring for the new/updated provider list query and integrate it into `frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResultsPage.tsx`, including loading and error states with English user-facing text.

quotes: ENSURE THAT AS A CLIENT I CAN SEE EVERY SERVICE PROVIDER WHO IS ENGAGED OR NOT. RIGHT NOW I CANT SEE ANYTHING

acceptanceCriteria: `ProviderResultsPage` uses a React Query hook (in `frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts`) to fetch providers instead of `const providers: ProviderProfileView[] = [];`.
While loading, the page shows a clear loading UI (e.g., skeletons or "Loading providers…").
If the backend call fails, the page shows a clear English error message and a retry action.
Selecting a provider still opens the existing preview dialog and continues to poll the selected provider every ~3 seconds while the dialog is open.

constraints: Do not modify files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (compose existing UI components instead).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; only create `backend/migration.mo` if a state schema upgrade is required.
All user-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Implement advanced geospatial proximity search or sorting logic.
Implement real-time subscriptions/WebSockets for engagement updates (polling is acceptable and already used).
Change payment/unlock behavior or contact gating as part of this fix.
